title: Everyday Phrases — Self-Checkout at the Store
scene_zh: 超市自助結帳 · 情境對話
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🛒 實用超市自助結帳必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Self-Checkout at the Store
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用超市自助結帳情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從掃描裝袋、蔬果過秤、付款小票到請店員協助，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Self-Checkout at the Store phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering scanning, weighing produce, payment, receipts and asking staff for help. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's try the self-checkout today.
dialogue.zh: 我們今天來試試自助結帳吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, but is it easy to use?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ bət ɪz ɪt ˈizi tə juz/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，但它的用法簡單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just put your items on the belt.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst pʊt jɔr ˈaɪtəmz ɑn ðə bɛlt/
dialogue.zh: 把東西放在傳送帶上就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this? The scanner is right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs ðə ˈskænər ɪz raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 像這樣嗎？掃描器就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that's the right spot to start.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæts ðə raɪt spɑt tə stɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 對，那就是開始的正確位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now do I press something first?
dialogue.zh: 那我先要按什麼按鈕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Touch the screen to begin.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, it says scan your items.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ɪt sɛz skæn jɔr ˈaɪtəmz/
dialogue.zh: 看到了，它叫我掃描商品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, grab the first bag of rice.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɡræb ðə fɜrst bæɡ ʌv raɪs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beep! Did it catch that one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, one item on the screen now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn ˈaɪtəm ɑn ðə skrin naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有，螢幕上已經出現一件了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, this is pretty simple.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold each item up to the light.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld iʧ ˈaɪtəm ʌp tə ðə laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 把每件商品舉到掃描光前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You mean the glass scanner?
dialogue.zh: 你是說那塊玻璃掃描區嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's it, the light reads the code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪt ðə laɪt ridz ðə koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，那道光會讀取條碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, the rice is done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next we need a place for bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst wi nid ə pleɪs fər bæɡz/
dialogue.zh: 接下來我們得找個裝袋的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can use our cloth bags.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以用自備的布袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take out the big one first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This canvas one is nice and strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈkænvəs wʌn ɪz naɪs ænd strɔŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hand me the big bag of chips.
dialogue.phonetic: /hænd mi ðə bɪɡ bæɡ ʌv tʃɪps/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, the chips might crush.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good point, chips go on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, nothing got crushed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rice goes in the other bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə raɪs ɡoʊz ɪn ði ˈʌðər bæɡ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the scale under the belt?
dialogue.zh: 放在傳送帶下方的秤台上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it checks the weight too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says put item in bag.
dialogue.zh: 它提示「請將商品放入袋中」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? That's how it knows you scanned.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðæts haʊ ɪt noʊz ju skænd/
dialogue.zh: 看到了嗎？它就是這樣確認你掃過的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, next item coming up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This time let me scan the pasta.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs taɪm lɛt mi skæn ðə ˈpɑstə/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll hold the bags open.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我幫你把袋口撐開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beep! Pasta is on the list.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I just placed it in the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dʒʌst pleɪst ɪt ɪn ðə bæɡ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The total went up already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, the screen keeps the count.
dialogue.zh: 不錯耶，螢幕幫我們記著數量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many items do we have?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在有幾件商品了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only three so far, so light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's the canned soup for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it so the barcode faces me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt soʊ ðə ˈbɑrˌkoʊd ˈfeɪsəz mi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This can won't scan at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the code on the bottom.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, that worked. Cans are tricky.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, there's no rush.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The yellow tag shows the price.
dialogue.zh: 黃色標籤上寫的是特價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two dollars — what a deal!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like watching the little list grow.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ˈwɑtʃɪŋ ðə ˈlɪtəl lɪst groʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡看清單一項項變長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, it feels like a game.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu ɪt filz laɪk ə ɡeɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，感覺像在玩遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you scan the apples?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, fruit needs a different step.
dialogue.zh: 等等，水果要用不一樣的步驟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh right, fruit comes before bagging.
dialogue.zh: 喔對，水果要先處理再裝袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's move them over there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bread is next in the basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə brɛd ɪz nɛkst ɪn ðə ˈbæskɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft bread, careful in the bag.
dialogue.zh: 麵包很軟，裝袋時要小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put bread on top, never under.
dialogue.zh: 麵包要放最上面，不能壓在下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good tip, it gets crushed fast.
dialogue.zh: 提醒得好，它一下就被壓扁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beep! One loaf of bread.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's on the screen already.
dialogue.zh: 螢幕上已經看得到它了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This box is heavy for one hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bɑks ɪz ˈhɛvi fər wʌn hænd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide it across the belt instead.
dialogue.zh: 那就沿著傳送帶推過去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay… beep! Did that count?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the soap is on the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə soʊp ɪz ɑn ðə lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 有，肥皂已經在清單上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This machine is faster than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs məˈʃin ɪz ˈfæstər ðæn aɪ θɔt/
dialogue.zh: 這台機器比我想像中快多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No long line, no waiting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the best part of this.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scan the eggs, please, gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, and nothing broke at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, eggs are so fragile.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，雞蛋真的太容易破了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two bottles of juice are left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The large ones or small ones?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The large ones, we have a party.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɑrdʒ wʌnz wi hæv ə ˈpɑrti/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's scan both of them.
dialogue.zh: 那我們兩瓶都掃一下吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beep, beep, two more done.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're almost at the end.
dialogue.zh: 我們快掃到最後一件了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One snack bag under the basket.
dialogue.zh: 籃子底下還有一包零食。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it, scanning it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that everything from our list?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think we got every item.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's count: ten on the screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten in the bags, that's right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No paper bags? That's fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We brought our own, remember?
dialogue.zh: 我們自帶袋子了，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh yes, the cloth ones! Good.
dialogue.zh: 喔對，那個布環保袋！真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heavy things go at the bottom.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the screen says payment.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already? This was so fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, I forgot the chocolate bar.
dialogue.zh: 等等，我忘了那塊巧克力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Haha, one more scan then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beep! Chocolate is safe now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's dark chocolate, your favorite.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You remembered! That's really nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Nothing else is left.
dialogue.zh: 看吧？這下真的沒東西了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen says more items to scan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin sɛz mɔr ˈaɪtəmz tə skæn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we're done. Press a button.
dialogue.zh: 沒了，掃完了，按個按鈕吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one is no more items?
dialogue.zh: 哪個才是「沒有更多商品」？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The green one at the bottom.
dialogue.zh: 就是最下面那顆綠色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pressed it, now it shows choices.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Payment or a rewards card?
dialogue.zh: 是付款還是會員積分卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the next step, I guess.
dialogue.zh: 那應該是下一步的事了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cart is finally empty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh wait, the apples aren't scanned.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ weɪt ðə ˈæpəlz ˈɑr ənt skænd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, fruit goes on the scale.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I put them, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a side scale by the bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə saɪd skeɪl baɪ ðə bæɡz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen wants a code for them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin wɑnts ə koʊd fər ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 螢幕要輸入它們的代碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A code? What code is that?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Produce has numbers, not barcodes.
dialogue.zh: 蔬果用的是編號，不是條碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where can we find those numbers?
dialogue.zh: 那要去哪裡找這些編號？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the sign above the bins.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə saɪn əˈbʌv ðə bɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 看貨架上方的那塊牌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here! Apples are number four.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Type four on the touch screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay… did it weigh them?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, see? Half a kilo now.
dialogue.zh: 有啊你看，現在是半公斤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half? I picked four apples!
dialogue.zh: 半公斤？我挑了四顆蘋果耶！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe one fell off the scale.
dialogue.zh: 可能有一顆掉下秤台了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me set them down again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it reads one full kilo.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'll press the button.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The price looks fair to me.
dialogue.zh: 這個價格我覺得挺合理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Apples are cheap this week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next up: the oranges, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same steps? Weight, then code?
dialogue.zh: 一樣步驟嗎？先秤再輸入代碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, you learned it fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am a fast learner!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, the machine made a sound.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What sound? Like an alarm?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says unexpected item in bag.
dialogue.zh: 它顯示「袋區出現不明物品」。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But I only bagged the oranges.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the weight changed too fast.
dialogue.zh: 可能是重量變化太快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How do I clear this error, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ klɪr ðɪs ˈɛrɔr ðɛn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the bag off completely.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I lifted it all the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ ˈlɪftɪd ɪt ɔl ðə weɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now put it back, gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, the red light stopped.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? It accepts the weight now.
dialogue.zh: 看？它現在接受這個重量了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This machine is so picky.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It just wants things done right.
dialogue.zh: 它只是想讓一切照規矩來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair enough, let's keep going.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we scan these grapes yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, grapes need their own code.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their code is on the green sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr koʊd ɪz ɑn ðə ɡrin saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 它們的編號在綠色牌子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, twenty-two. Typing now.
dialogue.zh: 看到了，二十二號，我輸入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The weight looks good now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, boxes keep them fresh.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I scanned the lettuce by mistake.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mistake? Did it charge us?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It beeped twice, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can we undo a wrong scan?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's an option: cancel last item.
dialogue.zh: 有個選項：取消最後一件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, the total came down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That button just saved us money.
dialogue.zh: 那顆按鈕幫我們省了錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's read the screen more closely.
dialogue.zh: 我們要把螢幕看仔細點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cucumber has a sticker.
dialogue.zh: 這根小黃瓜上貼著標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stickers carry the store code.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beep! That one worked right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stickers beat the number pad.
dialogue.zh: 貼標籤比輸入編號方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, potatoes in a mesh bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does a mesh bag need weighing?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, that one has its own code.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðæt wʌn hæz ɪts oʊn koʊd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'll scan it like normal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful — the light missed it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No beep? Let me try again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold it flat against the glass.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There it is — loud beep!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flat and close works every time.
dialogue.zh: 放平、靠近，每次都能成功。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're a self-checkout expert.
dialogue.zh: 你簡直是自助結帳專家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An expert after ten minutes? Ha!
dialogue.zh: 幾分鐘就變專家啦？哈哈！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You fixed every problem yourself.
dialogue.zh: 問題全都是你自己搞定的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost — the peppers are next.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet peppers or hot ones?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The red ones, from the big bin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛd wʌnz frʌm ðə ɡɪɡ bɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You find the code, I'll grab them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju faɪnd ðə koʊd aɪl ɡræb ðɛm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peppers are number seventeen, see?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the scale… one kilo.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It charged less than I expected.
dialogue.zh: 算出來的價比我預期低。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Less is always good, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This melon is too big for here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈmɛlən ɪz tu bɪɡ fər hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這顆甜瓜太大了，這裡放不下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shelf scale takes heavy things.
dialogue.zh: 邊架上的秤可以秤重的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, the stand next to us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Code first, then weigh it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Melon done — two whole kilos.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's dinner and a snack.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something's beeping near the belt.
dialogue.zh: 傳送帶旁邊又有東西在叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, did we drop fruit?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A lemon rolled off the scale.
dialogue.zh: 一顆檸檬從秤台滾下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's why it flags the weight.
dialogue.zh: 原來是這樣報重量異常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll place it back, slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clear now? No more red light?
dialogue.zh: 正常了沒？紅燈沒再亮吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green again. Crisis over.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You handled that like a pro.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky guess, but I'll take it.
dialogue.zh: 運氣好而已，但我收下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time I'll be even faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything fresh is packed now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the frozen items left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Frozen food scans like normal stuff.
dialogue.zh: 冷凍食品跟一般的掃法一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch for frost on the code.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Frost hides barcodes, good point.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it, then scan — beep!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's our last fresh item.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now let's get to the payment.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready to pay? Pick a way.
dialogue.zh: 可以付款了，選一種方式吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card, cash, or phone?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen shows all three choices.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll use my debit card.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, do you have the store card?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt du ju hæv ðə stɔr kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 等等，你有商店會員卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The membership one? Why?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It gives a discount on everything.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, I left it home today.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ aɪ lɛft ɪt hoʊm təˈdeɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe your phone has a digital one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi jɔr foʊn hæz ə ˈdɪdʒɪtəl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 你手機裡可能有電子會員卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check my app quickly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you remember the app name?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's in my email, wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take it slow, nobody's waiting.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it! Here is the code.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show the screen to the scanner.
dialogue.zh: 把手機螢幕對著掃描器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like a ticket at a movie?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly that — hold it steady.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beep! It says welcome back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? Instant member savings.
dialogue.zh: 看到了吧？會員馬上省錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our total dropped two dollars!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That pays for the melon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll never leave my card again.
dialogue.zh: 我以後再也不會忘帶卡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any paper coupons in your purse?
dialogue.zh: 你錢包裡有紙本優惠券嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe two, right here somewhere.
dialogue.zh: 好像有兩張，就在這裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coupons scan before payment.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which slot takes paper codes?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The small glass window, below.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it flat and slide it in.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɪt flæt ænd slaɪd ɪt ɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One down! Coupon accepted.
dialogue.zh: 那張成功了！優惠券可用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The second says it expired.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Expired ones never work, sadly.
dialogue.zh: 可惜，過期的從來不管用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Into the trash it goes, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就把它丟進垃圾桶吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, the other one scanned fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty cents off the juice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small money, but it counts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every cent helps today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now press pay with card.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I insert or tap it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap is fastest, just touch it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It beeped once. Did it work?
dialogue.zh: 它只嗶了一聲，成功了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says try another card.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My bank always does this.
dialogue.zh: 我那邊的銀行老是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the tap was too quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me hold it longer now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait for the happy sound.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, it says not approved.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two fails — let's try cash.
dialogue.zh: 兩次都失敗，改用現金吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I was ready to pay cash.
dialogue.zh: 我本來都準備付現金了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you carry cash these days?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, in my front pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cash works here, too, you know.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where do the bills go in?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Choose cash, and the slot opens.
dialogue.zh: 選現金，投鈔口就會打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Insert bills one at a time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coins go in the round cup.
dialogue.zh: 硬幣放進那個圓形小杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It counts them on the screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Part paid, twelve dollars remain.
dialogue.zh: 付了一部分，還差十二塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll finish it with my other card.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈfɪnɪʃ ɪt wɪð maɪ ˈʌðər kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 剩下的我用另一張卡結。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Splitting payment is allowed here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, that solves my empty wallet.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，救了我空空的錢包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card again, and tap, remember?
dialogue.zh: 又輪到卡了，記得要感應。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap, wait, happy sound. Done.
dialogue.zh: 貼一下、等一下、嗶一聲，好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paid in full! What a moment.
dialogue.zh: 全部付清！多麼有儀式感。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels like winning something.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want a printed receipt?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep it for returns.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or an email receipt instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper is fine right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it comes, from the slot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, it keeps printing out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the item count on it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, one number looks wrong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrong? Show me that line.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The soap price is doubled.
dialogue.zh: 肥皂的價錢被算成了兩倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the scanner ring it twice?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe, when I moved my hand.
dialogue.zh: 可能是我手一動又掃到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's why we check receipts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can the machine undo that?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It already closed our session.
dialogue.zh: 它已經結束了我們這單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we need a worker's help.
dialogue.zh: 那就需要工作人員幫忙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a call button on screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait — first read the whole receipt.
dialogue.zh: 先別急，把收據從頭讀一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea, check before we ring.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The melon was priced right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any other wrong numbers?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only that one soap line.
dialogue.zh: 只剩肥皂那一行有問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So they owe us three dollars.
dialogue.zh: 所以他們多收我們三塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A refund, then. How does it work?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈriˌfʌnd ðɛn haʊ dʌz ɪt wɜrk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The staff can fix it right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stæf kæm fɪks ɪt raɪt hɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should we press the call button?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but let me hold the receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bət lɛt mi hoʊld ðə rɪˈsit/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It flashes now — someone will come.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Meanwhile, let's bag the last box.
dialogue.zh: 趁這空檔把最後一盒收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Frozen things go in their own bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfroʊzən θɪŋz ɡoʊ ɪn ðɛr oʊn bæɡ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clever, keeps everything cold longer.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，這樣能保冷久一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're ready for anything now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The little light on the pole blinks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪtəl laɪt ɑn ðə poʊl blɪŋks/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's our helper being called.
dialogue.zh: 代表我們呼叫到人員了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect timing, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here she comes now, walking over.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, thanks for coming by.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our receipt has one mistake, see?
dialogue.zh: 我們收據上有一處錯誤，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go ahead, show her that line.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, the soap rang twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, she's fixing that now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you! Can you undo it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She needs a key card first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No hurry, we can wait here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There! The refund is done.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Will the money go back on the card?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˈmʌni ɡoʊ bæk ɑn ðə kɑrd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two or three days, she says.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's fast enough for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else? She wants to know.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Actually, the juice seems pricey.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check the shelf price.
dialogue.zh: 我們去貨架核對一下價格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can you pause the machine?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She points — the shelf is close.
dialogue.zh: 她一指，貨架就在不遠處。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, we're right behind you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sign says three for two dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə saɪn sɛz θri fər tu ˈdɑlərz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We only bought two of them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So full price applies, after all.
dialogue.zh: 那就還是得按原價算了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, I misread that deal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy mistake, believe me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for checking with us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She smiles, it's really her job.
dialogue.zh: 她笑說，這本來就是她的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're kind, that helps a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then she asks about the bags.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I never scanned a bag!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bags cost ten cents each here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡一個袋子要十美分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, we used the cloth ones.
dialogue.zh: 喔，我們用的是環保布袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cloth bags are always free.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we owe nothing more?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All set now, she tells us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can we get a new receipt?
dialogue.zh: 可以給我們一張新收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fixed receipt is printing now.
dialogue.zh: 修正過的收據正在列印。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So quick! The paper came out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go on, match it with our bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ ɑn mætʃ ɪt wɪð ˈaʊər bæɡz/
dialogue.zh: 來，跟袋子裡的東西對一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count, count… yes, perfect.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says to keep it seven days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz tə kip ɪt ˈsɛvən deɪz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In case we need to return?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, or for a warranty.
dialogue.zh: 對，退貨或保固都用得上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll keep it safe, promise.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asks if we need more.
dialogue.zh: 她還問要不要別的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you solved it all today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says to enjoy the party.
dialogue.zh: 她說讓我們派對玩得盡興。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will, it was fun actually.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next week, she says with a wave.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst wik ʃi sɛz wɪð ə weɪv/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, see you next week!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I bet the machines miss us now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɛt ðə məˈʃɪnz mɪs ʌs naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我打賭機器都想我們了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! We'll be back, for sure.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, grab the bag handles.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You take the heavy one, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This rice bag weighs a ton.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cloth one handles it fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Left arm full, right arm too.
dialogue.zh: 左手臂滿了，右手也滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't drop the eggs, seriously!
dialogue.zh: 雞蛋千萬別掉了，說真的！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm hugging them like babies.
dialogue.zh: 我像抱寶寶一樣抱著它們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful at the corner, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過轉角處還是要小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The exit path is clear now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one more gate to pass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The guard scans big bags sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 保全有時會檢查大袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours may beep at the sensor.
dialogue.zh: 我們的可能會觸發感應器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If it beeps, just smile and wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ɪt bɪps dʒʌst smaɪl ænd weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 要是響了，微笑等著就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The guard checks receipts, that's all.
dialogue.zh: 保全只是核對收據而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There we go — green light, walking.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No beep! We passed like pros.
dialogue.zh: 沒響！我們老練地過關了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Self-checkout: defeated today.
dialogue.zh: 自助結帳，今天被我們搞定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Defeated? You made friends with it.
dialogue.zh: 搞定？你明明跟它交朋友了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Same time next week?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you scan the melon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. I love weighing fruit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You and that scale, a true pair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ænd ðæt skeɪl ə tru pɛr/
dialogue.zh: 你跟那台秤真是天生一對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Car's right over in row ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trunk open, loading the bags now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Groceries in, engines on.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snack bag first — chocolate time.
dialogue.zh: 先開零食袋，巧克力時間到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save some for the party!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No promises from this driver.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One stop left: the gas pump.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill it up while I stretch legs.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪl ɪt ʌp waɪl aɪ strɛtʃ lɛɡz/
dialogue.zh: 加滿吧，我順便伸展一下腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten gallons… almost there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want air for your tires too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, while the tank is filling.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pump says thank you, drive off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Full tank, full trunk, full hearts.
dialogue.zh: 油箱滿、後車廂滿、心裡也滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best shopping trip ever, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說真的，這是最好的一次購物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home in twenty minutes flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: GPS says the road is clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Music on, seats back, relax.
dialogue.zh: 音樂開著，座椅放倒，放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This chocolate is really good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Share a square, don't be selfish.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, two squares, my tax.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair tax, I accept the deal.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Party starts in one hour sharp.
dialogue.zh: 派對一小時後準時開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plates, cups, all in the trunk.
dialogue.zh: 盤子杯子全在後車廂裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both juice bottles — lift with care!
dialogue.zh: 那兩瓶果汁，端的時候小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You planned this so well today.
dialogue.zh: 你今天把一切都安排好啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We worked as one great team.
dialogue.zh: 我們像一支超棒的隊伍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Self-checkout taught us patience.
dialogue.zh: 自助結帳教會了我們耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And teamwork, and cheap melons.
dialogue.zh: 還教會了團隊合作，還有便宜的甜瓜。
